primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.
So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 23:25は固有名ではなく「岩」とだけ記す。Sela Hammahlekothの名は23:28で初めて付く。
固定WEB本文がこの節で場所をSela Hammahlekothと命名する。
